integrity: The full-parameter argument is analytic. Finite sampled computations are supplementary diagnostics and are not asserted to certify the continuum. A 2010 initial preprint predates the later published formulation of the pairwise-distance conjecture.
scientific_limitations: This is a theorem for reflection-symmetric five-vertex equilateral convex configurations only. No assertion for asymmetric pentagons or higher odd n is proved. Equality lies on the weak-convexity boundary with one straight angle; strictly convex pentagons attain only the sharp supremum. Historical equivalence remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp vertex-distance bound for reflection-symmetric equilateral pentagons
